Anya K: Heads up — AWS Marketplace invoice for Feb shows ~32k USD mismatch vs our internal reseller calc for GPU reserved/reseller line items :eyes:
Finance Bot: New marketplace invoice uploaded: INV-2026-02-1487 (seller: 0123456789)
Liam P: Can you drop the invoice lines? Is this the dedicated-reserved SKU mapping we looked at last week?
Anya K: pasted CSV snippet:
```
invoice_id,sku,description,quantity,unit_price,total
INV-2026-02-1487,amz-sku-gpu-reserved-v1,Reserved GPU Hours - eu-west-1,1200,25.00,30000.00
INV-2026-02-1487,amz-sku-reseller-fee,Marketplace Reseller Fee,1,2100.00,2100.00
```
Miguel R: That reseller fee line looks high. Our contract says 5% marketplace fee for that seller, not a flat 2100. Could be ratecard vs invoice mismatch.
SRE Ops: Also flagging: we saw ~300 GPU-hours routed to eu-west-1 test pool last month due to mis-tagged nodes — might explain some quantity delta.
Sara T: Ran quick Athena query against billing export, result: billed_gpu_hours = 1512, internal_usage_gpu_hours = 1200 -> delta 312. Query: `SELECT sku, SUM(usage_hours) FROM billing WHERE invoice_id='INV-2026-02-1487' GROUP BY sku;`
Liam P: So two issues: (A) quantity delta (312 hrs) and (B) rate/fee mismatch on invoice lines.
Anya K: I've matched internal product_id -> marketplace sku map; two SKUs (amz-sku-gpu-reserved-v1, amz-sku-gpu-reserved-v1-legacy) both billing to same product on invoice, causing double-counting when our parser expects only one.
Miguel R: I'll open a support case with AWS Marketplace (I can escalate). Notes to include: invoice id, seller id, 312-hour delta, evidence from billing export + node-tagging.
Finance Bot: Created ticket MW-4521 and Slack thread in #vendors referencing INV-2026-02-1487
SRE Ops: I'll run a cluster audit to confirm any auto-assigned test pools and share pod/node tags by region — ETA 3h.
Liam P: Action items:
 - Miguel: AWS ticket + ratecard proof (due EOD)
 - SRE Ops: cluster tag audit (ETA 3h)
 - Sara: full billing vs usage diff report (CSV)
 - Anya: update reconciliation sheet and hold settlement adjustment until we confirm
Anya K: assigning in tracker, pinging reseller contact (reseller-ops@partnerco.com). Also adding note to avoid auto-merge of SKU aliases in billing parser.
Miguel R: Taking AWS case. If AWS confirms they rolled a legacy SKU into the current one we can apply a correction or credit.
Sara T: Uploaded detailed CSV to finance drive: `gs://rdw-finance/marketplace_recon/INV-2026-02-1487.csv`
Liam P: Thanks — keep updates here. If AWS doesn't respond within 48h we'll prepare an interim billing adjustment and flag to revenue ops. :thumbsup:
Anya K: TY all. Will follow up with final reconciliation and Jira link once we have AWS reply and SRE audit.
